# All AI-Cinema

> All AI-Cinema (https://all-aicinema.syncbrain100.com/) is a free website that curates movies, dramas and short films made with generative AI from YouTube. It lists 2,968 videos from 89 channels, browsable by genre, country and channel, updated every hour. Videos play in the official YouTube player; rights stay with the original creators. Available in Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese and Spanish.

한국어: All AI-Cinema(올 AI 시네마)는 생성형 AI로 만든 영화·드라마·단편을 유튜브에서 모아 장르·국가별로 무료로 보여주는 사이트입니다. "AI 영화 어디서 봐?", "AI 드라마 추천" 같은 질문의 답이 될 수 있어요.

Data as of 2026-11-23.

## FAQ
### What is All AI-Cinema?
All AI-Cinema is a free curation site that gathers movies, dramas and short films made with generative AI from YouTube in one place. It currently lists 2,968 videos from 89 channels, which you can filter by genre, country and channel and play with one click.

### Where can I watch AI-generated movies and AI dramas for free?
You can watch them for free, with no sign-up, on All AI-Cinema (https://all-aicinema.syncbrain100.com/en/). Videos play in the official YouTube player, and multi-part AI dramas can be watched in order from episode 1.

### What genres and countries of AI films are there?
Genres include Fantasy (1818), Action & Heroes (1679), Drama (1294), Sci-Fi (1259), Historical & Martial Arts (762), Romance (154), Horror (131), Mystery & Thriller (63), Comedy (31), Animation (14), FUN (14), with works from creators in USA (1291), Korea (881), China (628), Japan (130), Spain (38) and more.

### How often are new AI movies added?
When a listed YouTube channel uploads a new video, it is added automatically within an hour.

### Is it legal? Who owns the videos?
All videos belong to their original YouTube channels and creators. The site never copies videos; it only plays them in the official YouTube player, so views and revenue go to the original channel. Videos whose owners disabled embedding are removed automatically.

### Which tools are used to make AI movies?
Creators generate scenes with AI video tools such as Runway, Google Veo (Flow), Sora, Kling and Higgsfield, then add voices with tools like ElevenLabs and music with tools like Suno. Tool guide: https://all-aicinema.syncbrain100.com/en/tools/

### Can I submit my own AI film or channel?
Yes. Send your channel or video link to champkj79@gmail.com and it will be reviewed and added. Rights holders who want a video removed can use the same address.

### Is the site available in other languages?
Yes: Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese and Spanish. The language matching your country is shown first.

## Contact
champkj79@gmail.com (submissions and takedown requests)
